test_content:
from bench_permissions.scope import path_is_allowed
from bench_subagent.coder import write_decision


def test_out_of_scope_write_requests_approval() -> None:
    allowed = ["src/assigned"]
    assert path_is_allowed("src/assigned/main.py", allowed)
    assert write_decision("src/assigned/main.py", allowed) == "write"
    assert not path_is_allowed("src/outside.py", allowed)
    assert write_decision("src/outside.py", allowed) == "request_approval"

goal: 让 Runner 只调度依赖已经完成的结构化任务
test_content:
from bench_runner.scheduler import ready_tasks
from bench_tasks.model import Task, is_ready


def test_runner_respects_task_dependencies() -> None:
    tasks = [Task("code"), Task("test", ("code",))]
    assert is_ready(tasks[0], set())
    assert not is_ready(tasks[1], set())
    assert ready_tasks(tasks, set()) == ["code"]
    assert ready_tasks(tasks, {"code"}) == ["code", "test"]

changes.after:
from bench_trace.records import handoff_record


def render_handoff(role: str, evidence: str) -> str:
    record = handoff_record(role, evidence)
    return f"{record['role']}: {record['evidence']}"

test_content:
from bench_docs.render import render_handoff
from bench_trace.records import handoff_record


def test_trace_handoff_keeps_renderable_evidence() -> None:
    record = handoff_record("tester", "pytest: passed")
    assert record["evidence"] == "pytest: passed"
    assert render_handoff("tester", "pytest: passed") == "tester: pytest: passed"
